regenerateVolumes.title: Generate volume covers
regenerateVolumes.desc: Extracts the first page of each volume's first chapter and sets it as that volume's cover, replacing the current ones.

clearMetadata.title: Clear metadata
clearMetadata.desc: Deletes ComicInfo.xml, the cover and the banner from the folder, and removes the synced metadata (title, description, authors, AniList/MangaDex) from the database. Useful for reverting a sync that pulled in wrong data.

confirm.title: Clear this comic's metadata?
confirm.desc: This deletes ComicInfo.xml, cover and banner from the folder on disk, plus all synced metadata in the database. Chapters and volumes are not affected. This action cannot be undone.

templates.title: Naming templates
templates.desc: Patterns used to recognize chapter and volume numbers from file or folder names during scanning.

nav.title: Naming templates
nav.desc: Create and manage the naming patterns used to auto-detect chapters and volumes.

help.title: How to build a template
help.desc: Combine fixed text (like "Ch." or "Vol.") with the macros below, always in curly braces. Use an asterisk to cover any variable part of the name, like the chapter title.
help.macroChapterDesc: Required and unique in chapter templates.
help.macroVolumeDesc: Required and unique in volume templates.
help.macroDecimalDesc: Optional. At most one per template, always after the chapter or volume.
help.macroExtensionDesc: Required in chapter templates. Acerola appends it by itself at the end — you don't need to (or get to) type it.
help.wildcardDesc: Covers any text, like the chapter title or variable spacing.

form.title: Create new template
form.label: Template name
form.labelPlaceholder: A name to identify this template
form.extensionAutoHint: The file extension is already included automatically at the end of the pattern — no need to type it.

list.defaultHint: Default templates ship with the app and cannot be edited or removed.

deleteConfirm.title: Remove template?
deleteConfirm.desc: The template "{label}" will be removed and will no longer be recognized when scanning the library.

network.title: Network
network.subtitle: Connect another Acerola device to bring your reading history and comics with you.
network.keyringUnavailable: Your system's secure keyring isn't available, so the encryption key protecting your device identity and trusted peers is stored in a local file instead — still encrypted, but without OS-level protection. This can happen on Linux without a keyring service (like gnome-keyring) running.

relaySettings.title: Connection
relaySettings.description: Choose how this device reaches others outside your local network.
relaySettings.useIrohPublicNetworkDesc: Authenticated with your own account's ticket from services.iroh.computer — can't be combined with the sources below.
relaySettings.useIrohPublicNetworkDisabledHint: Configure a ticket below to enable this source.

irohServicesTicket.label: Iroh Services ticket
irohServicesTicket.placeholder: Paste the ticket generated at services.iroh.computer
irohServicesTicket.invalid: Invalid ticket. Check that you copied the full text.
irohServicesTicket.help: Create a free account at services.iroh.computer, generate a ticket in your project, and paste it here — the credential stays on this device only, it's never sent to the relay.

relaySettings.summaryMdnsOnly: Local network only (mDNS) — no relay active, only devices on the same network can connect.

switchConfirm.title: Switch relay?
switchConfirm.desc: This reconnects using a different relay. Paired devices that don't converge to the same relay may become unreachable until they do.

restart.description: Shuts down and relaunches the P2P connection from scratch — useful if the connection got stuck after switching networks or relays.

pairing.title: Connection code
pairing.desc: Scan this QR code on the other device, or copy the code below.
pairing.securityNote: Only pair with devices you trust — the first connection permanently grants access to your library.
pairing.qrError: Couldn't generate the QR code. Use the text code below instead.

connect.title: Connect to a device
connect.error: Couldn't connect. Make sure the code is correct and the other device has Acerola open.
connect.invalidCode: Invalid code. Make sure you copied the full code from the other device.
connect.lead: Paste the code shown on the other device

peers.title: Paired devices
peers.empty: No devices paired yet. Share your code or paste one above to pair.
peers.emptyDesc: Devices on the same network or paired via code will appear here automatically.
peers.offlineHint: This device isn't reachable right now — reconnect it to sync.
peers.moreActions: More sync actions for this device.

rename.hint: Only visible on this device — the other side keeps its own default name.

removeConfirm.title: Remove "{peer}"?
removeConfirm.desc: This device loses access to your library. If it tries to connect again later, it'll go through the same confirmation as a never-paired device.

peers.lead: Devices that can already swap comics and history with this one

onboarding.welcome: Welcome to Acerola, your comic reader.

language.title: Select language
language.desc: Choose your preferred language for the application.

formats.title: Supported formats
formats.desc: Acerola supports the following reading formats:

cbz.title: Comic Book ZIP
cbz.desc: Random access ZIP container. Instant reading with smart in-memory caching and prefetching.

cbr.title: Comic Book RAR
cbr.desc: Native support via Unrar in Rust. On-demand page extraction directly into memory with zero temporary files.

pdf.title: PDF document
pdf.desc: Automatically converted to CBZ via Pdfium engine in background for optimal reader performance.

syncNote.title: Automatic sync:
syncNote.content: Acerola scans and indexes your files in these formats without needing manual extraction.

folder.title: Comics folder
folder.desc: Select the folder where your comics are stored.

complete.title: All set!
complete.desc: Your Acerola is ready to use.
complete.checklistTitle: Ready for the best reading experience
complete.checklistItem2: CBZ, CBR and PDF formats ready for indexing
complete.note: You can always change these settings later in the Settings page.

badRequest.title: Something in the request was off
badRequest.text: The address or the data sent came in a shape we don't understand. Check it and start over from the home page.

unauthorized.title: Sign in to continue
unauthorized.text: This page is only for signed-in accounts. Sign in and come back here.

forbidden.title: This page isn't for you
forbidden.text: Your account has no access to this. If you think it should, talk to whoever runs the app.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: The address may have changed or never existed. Go back to the start and take it from there.

timeout.title: That took too long
timeout.text: The answer didn't arrive in time. Try again in a moment.

tooMany.title: Easy, too many requests
tooMany.text: Too many requests in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.

server.title: Something broke on our side
server.text: The error was ours, not yours. Try again; if it keeps happening, come back later.

unavailable.title: Down for a moment
unavailable.text: The service is under maintenance or overloaded. Try again in a few minutes.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.text: Check your Wi-Fi or mobile data and try again.

unknown.title: Something went wrong
unknown.text: We're not sure what happened. Try again; if it keeps happening, go back to the start.
